name: Shiranui Inori
source:
"Who are you calling ghost? I'm alive, unlike you".
Hobbies: Reading Manga, eating croquette bread

The phantom student.
Sometimes I see her at the "ghost clubroom" or on the rooftop, but I have never seen her attending classes.

She wears a long scarf and gloves even in summer, and her lone wolf personality makes some students spread rumours about her. She tries to avoid contact with others, and if someone persists to press her, they will receive a chilling "verbal attack".
